g.text: next j → load next Key Tile from HBM
384 queries share the same key tile set:
each q_i computes independently · each gets unique o_i · data loaded once, serves 384 queries

svg.text: Write 384 outputs back to HBM → repeat for all 300 Query Tiles
Matrix multiply Q @ K.T is identical!
